approved_scope.title: Let the release validator accept the Action archive gate in CI and docs before its release
approved_scope.description: Let the release validator accept the Action archive gate in CI and docs before its release
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: Release-version validation tooling only; no canonical spec owns these CI scripts
acceptance_criteria: validate-release-version.py finds the packaged Action consumer step by its version input while action-consumer also runs the archive gate; documented steps that set require-archived or archive-gate-only may pin @main only while the published Action default is 6.1.1 or older; every other documented step still must pin the published release; test-validate-release-candidate.py passes and proves the allowance expires.
